items.raw_excerpt: 一 大赛背景与目的 随着人工智能、大语言模型与智能体技术的快速发展，计算社会科学正在迎来新的研究范式。传统社会科学研究主要依赖调查、实验和观察等方法，在面对复杂社会系统中的多主体互动、动态演化和长期影响时，往往受到成本、规模和可重复性等限制。 大模型驱动的智能体为 社会科学研究 提供了新的可能。一方面， 智能体 可以作为具有不同特征的虚拟社会参与者， 在模拟环境中参与互动与决策 ，支持大规模、动态化的社会实验；另一方面， 智能体 也可以 作为研究者的智能科研伙伴 ，协助完成问题探索、假设生成、实验设计、结果分析等研究环节。 基于这一理念，本次大赛依托  AgentSociety² 平台 ，探索人工智能驱动的社会科学研究新方法。平台连接研究问题提出、假设生成、模拟实验、机制干预、结果分析与论文写作，构建一体化智能研究环境，支持参赛团队围绕重大社会问题构建虚拟社会系统，通过智能体交互模拟复杂社会过程，探索微观行为、群体互动与宏观社会现象之间的演化机制。 本次大赛设置七大研究方向，面向政策治理、政治制度、法律创新、数字经济、信息传播与社会演化等领域 ，鼓励参赛团队利用智能体社会模拟方法，开展传统方法难以实现的大规模、动态化、可干预社会实验，推动人工智能与社会科学的深度融合。 二 七大研究方向 本次大赛依托  AgentSociety² 平台 开展探索性研究。参赛团队可围绕重大社会问题构建可交互的虚拟社会系统，通过大规模智能体交互模拟复杂社会过程，探索微观个体行为、群体互动机制与宏观社会现象之间的演化规律，并开展情景推演、反事实分析与机制干预实验。本次大赛设置七大研究方向，分别面向政策治理、政治制度、法律创新、数字经济、信息传播与社会演化等领域，鼓励参赛团队利用智能体社会模拟方法，探索传统社会科学方法难以开展的大规模、动态化、可重复、可干预的社会实验，推动社会科

I. Competition Background and Purpose
With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, large language models, and intelligent agents, computational social science is ushering in a new research paradigm. Traditional social science research primarily relies on methods such as surveys, experiments, and observation, which are often constrained by cost, scale, and reproducibility when addressing multi-agent interactions, dynamic evolution, and long-term impacts in complex social systems. Large language model-driven agents offer new possibilities for social science research. On the one hand, agents can act as virtual social participants with diverse characteristics, engaging in interaction and decision-making within simulated environments, supporting large-scale, dynamic social experiments. On the other hand, agents can also serve as intelligent research assistants for researchers, helping to complete research stages such as problem exploration, hypothesis generation, experimental design, and result analysis. Based on this concept, this competition leverages the AgentSociety² platform to explore new AI-driven research methods for social science. The platform connects research problem formulation, hypothesis generation, simulation experiments, mechanism intervention, result analysis, and paper writing, building an integrated intelligent research environment. It supports participating teams in constructing virtual social systems around major social issues, simulating complex social processes through agent interaction, and exploring the evolutionary mechanisms between micro-level behavior, group interaction, and macro-level social phenomena. This competition establishes seven major research directions, covering fields such as policy governance, political institutions, legal innovation, digital economy, information dissemination, and social evolution, encouraging participating teams to utilize agent-based social simulation.
